scripts.emulators: mkdir -p .emulator-tmp/dev && TMPDIR="$PWD/.emulator-tmp/dev" sh scripts/with-java.sh firebase emulators:start --project demo-happs --import=./emulator-data --export-on-exit=./emulator-data
scripts.emulators:fresh: mkdir -p .emulator-tmp/dev && TMPDIR="$PWD/.emulator-tmp/dev" sh scripts/with-java.sh firebase emulators:start --project demo-happs
scripts.test:rules: mkdir -p .emulator-tmp/rules && TMPDIR="$PWD/.emulator-tmp/rules" sh scripts/with-java.sh firebase emulators:exec --config firebase.rules-test.json --only firestore,storage --project demo-happs-rules "vitest run --config vitest.rules.config.ts"
scripts.test:e2e: npm --prefix functions run build && mkdir -p .emulator-tmp/e2e && TMPDIR="$PWD/.emulator-tmp/e2e" sh scripts/with-java.sh firebase emulators:exec --config firebase.e2e.json --only auth,firestore,functions,storage --project demo-happs "playwright test"
scripts.emulators:real-auth: mkdir -p .emulator-tmp/dev-real && TMPDIR="$PWD/.emulator-tmp/dev-real" sh scripts/with-java.sh firebase emulators:start --project happss --only firestore,functions,storage --import=./emulator-data-real --export-on-exit=./emulator-data-real
